report_name: Knowsley Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used as the primary tool to identify potential cycling demand, inform the development of the cycle network, and identify desire lines for commuting cyclists.
other_tools_developed: Cycle Intervention Prioritisation Matrix, Walking Intervention Prioritisation Matrix, Walking Route Assessment Tool (WRAT), Cycling Level of Service (CLoS) tool
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP led to the identification of 18 Primary, 16 Secondary, and nine 'Missing Link' cycle routes, as well as 111 prioritised walking routes. It also resulted in the upgrading of routes 2, 3, 10, and 34 to high priority due to ringfenced funding from linked developments, and the removal of routes 5, 29, and 31 due to overlap with other identified routes.
pct_usage_quote: The main tool used in the development of the cycle network was the propensity to cycle tool (PCT).
